summary: Cabin lookout on Lookout Mountain in the Deschutes NF, built in the 1930s and now gone; no source describes what remains on the summit.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Former Fire Lookout Sites register, firelookout.com and the statewide lookout list

events.note: Given only as the 1930s; the register and firelookout.com both describe a cabin
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on May 11, 2011

evidence.supports: Cabin built in the 1930s and now gone
evidence.quote: Built in the 1930s, this cabin is now gone.

evidence.supports: Site lies in the Deschutes National Forest
Rex's page gives the 1920s with question marks
Statewide list marks the site gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give the 1930s. Rex's Fire Lookout Page gives the 1920s with question marks. The story uses the 1930s.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register, firelookout.com and the Rex page are the only pages with detail; the statewide list adds the gone status only. Two web searches found nothing on what remains today, so the story says no source describes the site now. The brief's access 'unknown' is left unfilled. A Deschutes NF historic-lookout eligibility study (digitalcollections.library.oregon.gov, node 275303) came up in search, but its PDF was not read; it may cover this site.
